name: clearward
description: Clearward — AI Financial Self-Defense Platform for Indian Retail Investors
author: Clearward Team

scripts.build:backend: export KERAS_HOME="$(pwd)/.keras_home" && export PYINSTALLER_CONFIG_DIR="$(pwd)/.pyinstaller_cache" && pyinstaller --name clearward-backend --onedir --distpath dist-backend --noconfirm --codesign-identity - --exclude-module tensorflow --exclude-module keras --exclude-module matplotlib --exclude-module tkinter --exclude-module PIL --exclude-module Pillow backend/server.py && codesign --force --deep --sign - dist-backend/clearward-backend
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && electron-builder --mac --win --config electron-builder.json
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.json
